text: The platform shall hold life state as one body. Each item shall show its origin. The platform shall not give a superseded value as the current value of an observed item.
rationale: Agents that read different values cannot be made to agree later. The platform makes an observed answer current, so an agent does not decide. A derived value has no identity that a later value replaces, so REQ-PL-015 carries it instead.

text: The platform shall answer exact-value queries over life state. The platform shall also answer meaning-based queries over life state.
rationale: An agent needs exact values and related values from the same body of data.

text: The platform shall acquire life data from defined external sources without an action by the user.
rationale: This function removes the failure that occurs when a person moves the data.

text: The platform shall report an external source that did not deliver data as its definition states.
rationale: A source can stop without a message. The system then reasons with confidence over data that is not true.

text: The platform shall direct work to agents in a declared hierarchy. The platform shall let an agent get an answer from another agent. An agent shall act only inside the authority that its position gives. An answer from another agent shall not increase that authority.
rationale: Position gives authority. An agent must not get more authority because it asks another agent.

text: The platform shall detect contention between agents for the same declared resource. Each contention that the platform detects shall be resolved or sent to the user.
rationale: Today nothing decides between domains. To decide priority is a judgement, and the platform does not make it. The platform detects the contention and makes sure that it is not lost.

text: The platform shall continue work when no client is connected. For any work that it holds, the platform shall give the agent that is responsible and the current state.
rationale: Work must continue after the conversation that started it stops. You cannot trust unattended work that you cannot see.

text: The platform shall evaluate declared conditions on a declared schedule. The platform shall derive declared indicators from life state on a declared schedule.
rationale: Detection is a scheduled evaluation. It is not a result of a conversation. An indicator with no owner is not measured.

text: The platform shall deliver messages to the user that the user did not request. For each message, the platform shall record the condition that started it and the values that satisfied the condition.
rationale: Without a channel to the user, the system can only answer. The platform holds the record. The platform does not write the words of the message.

text: The platform shall accept and return interaction in speech and in writing. The user shall be able to continue in a second client an exchange that started in a first client.
rationale: The user speaks on a telephone and writes in a working session. The user must be able to answer a later question from a different device.

text: The platform shall give a documented interface. The interface shall be sufficient for a client that another person wrote to operate an agent.
rationale: The user chooses a client from more than one.

text: The platform shall tell the difference between an action that needs the authorization of the user and an action that does not. The platform shall not do an action that needs authorization until it records an affirmative answer to a request that states that action.
rationale: Configuration sets which actions need consent. The design gives the difference and the block.

text: An action that communicates with a third party, commits funds, or gives the platform access to an external service shall need the authorization of the user.
rationale: The user states this as a hard boundary.

text: The platform shall record each action on the outside world. The record shall contain the agent that did the action, the time, and the authority for the action. No such action shall be reachable by a path that does not use REQ-PL-012.
rationale: You must be able to examine an external effect after it occurs. A gate that a path can go around is not a gate.

text: The platform shall tell the difference between observed data and inferred data. For each assertion, the platform shall give the data that it used to make the assertion and the time at which it made it.
rationale: If the system cannot identify an inference, it gives the inference as a fact.

text: The platform shall make, change and retire agents. The platform shall keep the history of the configuration of each agent. The platform shall let a person make a change that is common to all agents in one place.
rationale: Agents are components and change like components. Agents that a person edits one by one become different from each other.

text: The platform shall report its cost of operation for the current period. The platform shall report its own operational state and the operational state of its external sources.
rationale: A limit that you check after the invoice is not a control. A fault must become visible before it makes an answer wrong.

text: The platform shall derive patterns from observed data. The platform shall hold a pattern so that a reader can tell it apart from the data that the platform was given. The platform shall present a pattern for review and correction.
rationale: You must be able to separate derived data from stated data, or you cannot correct the right one. If you cannot review what the system learns, a wrong inference stays.

text: The platform shall not assert life-state content that it did not receive from a source and did not derive from data that it holds.
rationale: The platform is infrastructure. Content comes from sources and from agents. A derived value is not an exception, because the platform can give the data that the derivation used.

text: The recurring cost of operation shall not be more than USD 50 each month. This cost does not include the host.
rationale: The user states this limit.

text: Agents shall continue to be usable when the platform does not run.
rationale: If the platform stops, the set of agents becomes less capable but continues to work.

text: The loss of the host shall not cause the loss of life state.
rationale: The system must recover. A copy must be in another location.

text: Life state shall be unreachable from any path that makes published material.
rationale: Dropped by DEC-023. DEC-002 states that publishing is not a system function, so this requirement constrains a path that the platform does not have, and unreachability from it cannot be tested. REQ-PL-013, REQ-PL-014 and REQ-PL-024 answer the part of RSK-PL-005 that is inside the platform.

text: The platform shall serve to an agent only the part of life state that the position of the agent admits. The platform shall accept from an agent a write only to the part of life state that its position admits.
rationale: An agent that reads everything will read everything, because retrieval is cheap and relevance is hard. Data that one agent pulled from another domain then appears in its output, and nobody can find where a wrong answer came from. REQ-PL-005 already lets an agent get an answer from an agent whose position admits more. DEC-010 limits what an agent writes in the same way as what it reads, and this requirement stated the limit for serving only. Both halves are verified by one system, so rule 3 makes them one requirement and not two.

text: When the platform cannot continue to operate without an action by the user, the platform shall raise work for that action and send it to the user.
rationale: A credential stops being valid, or a new source needs approval. The platform cannot continue, and no agent raised the need. REQ-PL-006 covers contention between agents and REQ-PL-009 covers a condition that fires. Neither covers work that the platform raises to maintain itself.

text: The user shall be able to remove data that the platform holds.
rationale: The user states this. DEC-021 keeps life state until the user removes it, so removal is the only path out of the platform and it must exist. A personal system whose data the person cannot remove is not a personal system.
